title: 第十一章 目光如炬显露端倪第十二章 锋芒初现恩威并施
content_zh:
外亲。
指女系血亲相联系的亲眷。
铁棠听到这个消息，第一反应是怀疑知县，不过很快就抛去了这个念头。
只因知县修为太高了！
他如果要出手杀人，绝不会简单让人知道。
“你勿惊慌，仔细道来。”
袁骅刚要开口，却见门外走来两位穿着黑红袍，腰悬横刀的衙役。
他们步履矫健，气息沉稳，动静之间如豹、如虎，脖颈上裸·露的青筋刚劲有力，令人生畏。
这赫然是两位易筋境的衙役！
衙役的身份地位，无疑是要比捕快低上一筹，可这两位衙役的修为实力，简直骇人，超过许多捕快。
“拜见总捕头！”
“拜见总捕头！”
“何事？”铁棠一手凭空虚按，堵住了袁骅嘴巴。
其中一位衙役躬身说道：“回总捕头，知县大人有令，让您修炼完毕之后，马上去见内衙见他。”
“知道了，我待会就去。”
“总捕头....死者乃是知县大人的外亲，还望您周知。”衙役依旧躬着身，头颅半低垂，看不到表情。
眉毛微挑，铁棠一挥手：“带路！”
“请总捕头随我而来。”
两名衙役带着铁棠穿过宅门、二堂、内宅，在越过鼎仙楼之后，又走了一段路，在三省堂门前停了下来。
“总捕头，里面请！”

铁棠点了点头，上前轻叩三下大门。
“进来！”
里面传来一道威严声音。
嘎吱！
铁棠推门而进，左右两边是一座座高大的书架，上面摆着密密麻麻的书籍与卷宗。
正前方有一道伏案疾书的身影。
他身着素袍，气势不显，年纪约莫三十上下，两鬓却有点点白霜。
“知县大人，铁棠奉命前来。”
“你来了，稍等片刻。”
转身把大门关上，铁棠在身前找了个座椅坐下，闭目沉思。
死得是知县哪位外亲？
循着前身记忆一阵查探，并没有多少线索。
除了知县夫人和几个丫鬟之外，前身也没认识多少知县的身边人。
一柱香后，知县停笔。
虚空微微抖动，一股浓厚的笔墨香气在堂内萦绕。
content_en:
Foreign relatives.
Refers to the female relatives who are related by blood.
When Tie Tang heard the news, his first reaction was to doubt the magistrate, but he quickly abandoned this idea.
Just because the county magistrate’s cultivation level is too high!
If he wanted to kill someone, he would never let anyone know about it.
"Don't panic, tell me carefully."
Just as Yuan Hua was about to speak, he saw two government servants wearing black and red robes walking outside the door, with swords hanging on their waists.
Their steps are vigorous, their breath is calm, they move like leopards or tigers, and the exposed veins on their necks are strong and intimidating.
These are two Yamen servants from Yijin Realm!
The status of the yamen servants is undoubtedly lower than that of the police officers, but the cultivation strength of these two yamen servants is simply astonishing, surpassing that of many police officers.
"Meet the Chief Catcher!"
"Meet the Chief Catcher!"
"What's the matter?" Tie Tang pressed his hand out of thin air and blocked Yuan Hua's mouth.
One of the yamen servants bowed and said: "Go back to the boss to arrest the head. The county magistrate has an order for you to go to the yamen immediately after you finish practicing."
"I know, I'll go there later."
"The chief arrester... The deceased is the county magistrate's cousin. I hope you will know it." The yamen servant is still bowing, his head is half lowered, and his expression cannot be seen.
Tie Tang raised his eyebrows slightly and waved his hand: "Lead the way!"
"Please come with me, Chief Catcher."
The two government officials led Tie Tang through the gate of the house, the second hall, and the inner house. After passing the Dingxian Tower, they walked a while and stopped in front of the Sanshengtang.
"Captain Chief, please come inside!"
Tie Tang nodded, stepped forward and knocked on the door three times.
"Come in!"
A majestic voice came from inside.
Crunch!
Tie Tang pushed the door open and walked in. On the left and right sides were tall bookshelves filled with densely packed books and files.
Directly in front of him was a figure crouching at his desk writing a book.
He was dressed in plain robes and did not show off his imposing manner. He was about thirty years old, but his temples were a little bit hoarfrost.
"Master Magistrate, Tie Tang has been ordered to come."
"You're here, wait a moment."
Turning around and closing the door, Tie Tang found a seat in front of him and sat down, closing his eyes and thinking.
Which foreign relative from the county magistrate died?
After searching through the memory of his predecessor, there weren't many clues.
Except for the magistrate's wife and a few maids, my predecessor didn't know many people around the magistrate.
After one stick of incense, the magistrate stopped writing.
The void shook slightly, and a strong aroma of pen and ink lingered in the hall.
